corrections.S1: Asserted available nonfinite outputs invalidate transaction; binary64 elapsed must equal prior valid clock plus actual dt. Masked unavailable voltage placeholders remain unavailable.
corrections.S2: Exact intended query grid is required for completed_valid_arm; observed prefix plus its endpoint must be present; out-of-arm/future/unexpected/duplicate rows cannot establish completion.
corrections.S3: Nonfinite/malformed required16 estimates or truths and asserted-available nonfinite/reversed local ranges or invalid SDs invalidate full-query data. Unavailable placeholders remain permitted. A finite hull is an independent local diagnostic even at public/cold entry.
corrections.S4: Passing learned entry is included in first attainment; first_interval_end_hit remains explicit. Public/cold prior entries are excluded.
corrections.supplemental_truth: Two sorted truth streams merge in constant lookahead space; duplicate indices require equal records. No combined truth copy.
corrections.output_budget: One cap counts actual compressed gzip framing/data and JSON bytes before every write;4096 bytes reserved for failure summary. Exclusive paths and partial artifacts are retained.
corrections.validity_scope: Windows extending beyond the first validity failure cannot claim completed retention or finite-end sustained attainment; raw observed-prefix error statistics remain available.

tests.scope: Nine original methods plus five targeted regression methods; parameterized subcases cover required corrections.

root_requirements: Retain frozen intended end_index on incomplete arms.
Pass exact full intended required_query_indices and remaining per-arm global output allowance.
Pass the reconstructed supplemental JSONL path only when first-failure truth is absent or duplicated identically on the scheduled grid.
Run all arms sequentially within the one allowed scorer helper process.
Review final source/receipt and complete coupled preflight before primary.
